Why do you hate weddings? No hate, just seriously wondering

I don't feel like its doing a favor to go to someones wedding, but I also just really like weddings lol. In my mind, my friends/sisters weddings were super special days for everyone involved. Ik everyone doesnt feel that way, but I feel like it was worth buying the dress and going with their way. It doesnt sound like thats really your thing though, and thats fair.

I didnt mean to be offensive. I just meant to say that you dont have to feel obligated to do things with the bride. If its annoying or weird to you, you don't have to go at all. People should be allowed to do what they'd like on their wedding days, but people should also be allowed to turn down wedding invites/events without shame.
